title: Hand over the wheel
summary: Let a brain drive the SUV, pay it for progress and stop the ones that park.

steps.title: Hand the wheel to the brain
steps.body:
The brain named on line 6 is a small neural network. It reads its inputs and answers with two numbers: `brain.steer` and `brain.pedal`.

Pass them to `drive` so the brain controls the SUV. Its first weights are random, so it drives badly. Training is how it gets better.

check.message: Call drive with brain.steer and brain.pedal.

hints: Swap the two zeros for what the brain says.

steps.title: Points for progress
steps.body:
Training is evolution. Every SUV gets a score called fitness, the sum of its rewards, and the brains with the best fitness become the parents of the next generation.

Nothing is rewarded yet, so every SUV scores 0. Reward `route.gain`, the new ground the SUV covers along its route each tick. The check drives one trip with a fixed test driver.

check.message: The test drive should score some points.

hints: A reward line looks like this: reward +points * value.
Replace the comment with reward +0.02 * route.gain.

steps.title: Stop the ones that park
steps.body:
Some brains find out that standing still is safe. A trip that goes nowhere wastes the whole generation, so end it.

`car.noProgress` counts the seconds without new ground. Waiting at a red light, behind a car or for a person does not count. End the trip once it passes 8 seconds.

check.message: Add a stop rule that uses car.noProgress.

hints: A stop rule looks like this: stop "reason" when condition.
